note: The per-version vector roster (F10). Machine-readable; consumed by crates/antseal-core/tests/vector_index.rs. Contract + registration procedure: ../README.md, section 'The per-version index'. This file is an AUXILIARY: it is not itself a golden vector and is not frozen by FROZEN.sha256 — it is the roster, FROZEN.sha256 is the freeze.

vectors.pins: bundle kind: canonical .sealproof bytes for ten reveal shapes with three-layer diagnostic sidecars — including the two G24 shapes that carry a `level == d` GGM cover payload in D83's canonical `salt || 0x00*16` form (the n = 6 odd-boundary partial reveal, and the n = 1 file where that payload and `s_root` are the same 32 bytes) — INCLUDING the empty-anchor (UNANCHORED) bundle, a .sealproof carrying no OTS artifact, no TSA artifact and no receipt, which is the named M0 milestone artifact this slug's must-exist obligation owed (MVP-SPEC.md lines 112-114, 153)
the four salted commitments (unit/raw/canon/path): frozen (domain_tag, salt_label) pairs, HKDF-derived salts, and the digest each opens to (MVP-SPEC.md lines 93-95)
k_m derivation at the sentinel id and the frozen empty-AAD manifest AEAD (MVP-SPEC.md line 98)
hybrid author signatures: HKDF seeds, both public keys, the frozen ctx||0x00||body Ed25519 pre-image, deterministic ML-DSA-65 bytes, and the hybrid policy label (MVP-SPEC.md line 97)
k_u derivation, the seal_id||LE64(unit_id) AAD, the padded_length formula at both boundaries (empty unit, 256-aligned unit), and the resulting ciphertexts (MVP-SPEC.md line 91)

manifest kind: canonical deterministic-CBOR envelope bytes for six works, their two-layer diagnostic sidecars (F14's independent-CBOR cross-check target), and the work_id/anchor_digest each hashes to — which is also where F7's deferred committed-digest artifact lands (MVP-SPEC.md lines 73, 75, 98, 153)
the full 8-label HKDF registry: the length-prefixed injective info encoding and the OKM of every registered label (MVP-SPEC.md line 73, spec-mandated pairwise distinctness)
Ed25519 strict-verification rejects — S >= L, small-order and non-canonical R/A, wrong ctx — each bound to its stable crypto- code (MVP-SPEC.md line 97)
ML-DSA-65 canonical-encoding rejects — hint/z bounds and out-of-range encodings — plus the FIPS-204 and empty-ctx confusions (MVP-SPEC.md line 97)

content-model kind: the seal-side assembly's DERIVED values as a committed FILE rather than Rust constants — per-file descriptor fields, canonical rendition, synthetic s_root and fine_root, and per-unit work-global id, kind, byte range, true_length, fine-tree coverage and unit_commit obligation, for G14's four-file golden work plus the --force-text-on-invalid-UTF-8 branch it leaves untouched. That is what puts the assembly inside the Q5 native<->WASM bit-match lane, which compares vector files (MVP-SPEC.md lines 76, 78, 83, 85, 92, 94, 98, 153, 169). Pins no range-proof bytes, so decision D83's cover encoding cannot move it

fine-tree kind: the unbalanced n=6 opening that pins MSB-first GGM indexing, with every intermediate exposed — GGM node seeds, per-leaf salts, RFC 6962 unbalanced promotion, fine_root, and covers + boundary paths for reveal {2}, [4,6) and full [0,6); plus n=1, n=0 and n=5. Since D83 a cover entry at level == d carries the canonical leaf-level payload salt_i || 0x00*16 rather than the raw seed, so the three leaf-level openings (reveal {2}, reveal [1,3), and n=1's full reveal) pin that form; ggm_nodes[].seed and s_root are the GGM tree and are unaffected (MVP-SPEC.md lines 96, 169)

report kind: every M0 shape's canonical bundle mapped to the byte-exact serialized VerificationReport verify_bundle produces for it — full text reveal, partial reveal with leaf-exact covers, per-unit reveal at unbalanced n=6 (MSB-first GGM indexing through the pipeline), binary, --no-fine-tree, raw-mirror full reveal, empty and one-byte files, multi-file with an unrevealed committed placeholder, and the empty-anchor (UNANCHORED) bundle; report_json is the D29 encoding and the native<->WASM bit-match medium, and the set R28's multi-version suite extends per released version (MVP-SPEC.md lines 153, 167, 169)
